verdict.rationale: A user-writable plink.exe launched from cmd.exe on the Desktop opens an SSH session to 10.0.2.18 on port 80 with a remote port forward (-R) exposing the local RDP service (127.0.0.2:3389) on 127.0.0.3:4444, and it connects to that RDP service itself. This is a classic SSH-based tunnel that bypasses network controls and enables lateral RDP access.
